Container.Name: github-actions-runner-exporter
Container.Overview: Prometheus exporter for GitHub Actions self-hosted runner status (online/busy), plus repo CI health, PR counts, Dependabot alerts and job run/queue time history, polled from the org API on a rate-limit-friendly cache. Comes with an importable Grafana dashboard.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: prometheus grafana github actions runner metrics exporter ci dependabot

Config.Name: GitHub token
Config.Description: Fine-grained token: All repositories, read on Pull requests, Actions and Dependabot alerts, plus access to the org's self-hosted runners. See the README, Token permissions.
